title: gan-dump
summary: A temporary personal repository holding a copy of a thesis project's synthetic-data experimentation code, including a synthesizer script for training and evaluating tabular GAN models. The models/ctgan directory vendors the standalone CTGAN package and its synthesizer.py instantiates and trains a CTGANSynthesizer for tabular data generation.
